business_summary: Naipu Mining Machinery Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, produces, sells, and services heavy mining and mineral processing equipment and wear-resistant spare parts in China. The company offers slurry pumps, mill liners, trommels, screen media products, hydrocyclone products, pipes and hoses, and flotation rotor and stator products. It also provides beneficiation equipment optimization, beneficiation process design, consultation and optimization, and other value-added services. The company was formerly known as Jiangxi Naipu Mining Machinery and New Materials Co.,Ltd and changed its name to Naipu Mining Machinery Co., Ltd. in August 2020. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Guangxin, China.
